name: template-registry
body: Template registry / schema engine: schema model (fields, types, formats, body rules, sections) populated from project `template.yaml` manifests by the template-library-loader, with each template's kind taken from its directory (slides/ or sections/). Load-time checks (cycles, directory-kind check for section acceptance and field types, cross-kind name uniqueness, reserved names, references, examples), lookup and description. Owns the central, documented layout function map (v1: exactly `media "path"` → served URL of a file in templates/media/ or the theme dir) used when parsing layouts. Holds no compiled-in templates.
